widgets_values: 仅选择参考模式，可以在提示词输入框@图像，

我用夸克网盘给你分享了「教程分享8（H3-skill技能）」，点击链接或复制整段内容，打开「夸克APP」即可获取。

分辨率

( 先上传图1和图2给AI )

使用 h3-prompt-writing 技能，

- 室内家庭争吵短剧场景，竖屏短剧质感，真实真人表演，中式家庭/小饭馆室内环境，暖色灯光，背景有红色装饰和书法字幅，浅景深，情绪强烈，剪辑节奏紧凑。表演要求：真实短剧表演风格，不要夸张舞台腔。秦皓瑄的语气是愤怒、委屈、急切的反驳；中老年女性的语气是尖锐、强势、咄咄逼人的质问。两人之间有强烈对峙感，节奏逐步升级。画面风格：竖屏9:16，手机短剧质感，真人实拍感，浅景深，室内暖光，中近景为主，频繁正反打剪辑，背景保持生活化，不要科幻、不要古装、不要动画感。画面中不要出现任何字幕、文字、平台水印或贴片。

图1男人四川话说道：你不是答应我把你女儿嫁给我我，你怎么是这样的人，
图2女人四川话说道：当初我是答应过你，你看看你现在变成什么样的人了，你给我死了这条心吧，

How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; Picture 2 (from Shot 4) aligns with the 11.00-second mark of the target video.
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, vertical short-drama style, a 9:16 over-the-shoulder medium close-up frames the scene exactly as established by Picture 1. The young East Asian man (S1) — short textured black hair, charcoal gray crew-neck t-shirt under a dark chocolate brown zip-up collared jacket — stands in sharp focus facing left toward the woman whose blurred shoulder occupies the left foreground. He is mid-speech, eyebrows deeply furrowed, eyes wide and glistening with distress, neck muscles tensed. The warm beige interior with dark vertical calligraphy on the wall behind him and soft bokeh throughout the background remains consistent with Picture 1. The camera holds a static shot as the young man with a tight, urgent, emotionally strained voice (S1) speaks with rising anger and frustration in a Sichuan dialect: <d>[Chinese] 你不是答应我把你女儿嫁给我，你咋个是这种人哦！</d> His jaw tightens as he finishes the line, leaning forward slightly.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a reverse angle over-the-shoulder medium close-up from the man's side, facing the middle-aged woman. The middle-aged East Asian woman (S2) — dark black hair pulled back neatly into an updo, wearing a dusty mauve ribbed-knit turtleneck under an open muted plaid coat with wide notched lapels — stands in sharp focus. Behind her and to the left, a younger woman with long straight black hair and a camel-colored double-breasted coat stands blurred, also looking toward the man off-screen. The warm indoor background with a red decorative paper cut on the cream wall and blurred wooden shelving matches the domestic setting. The camera holds a static shot as the middle-aged woman with a sharp, piercing, domineering voice (S2) fires back with biting contempt in a Sichuan dialect: <d>[Chinese] 当初我是答应过你撒，</d> Her eyebrows raised high in angry disbelief, mouth tightening.

[Shot 3] At 00:06.500, the shot cuts back to the over-the-shoulder shot of the man from Shot 1, his expression now more desperate and wounded. The young man (S1) opens his mouth to speak again, then stops, his face flushing with humiliation and rage. His Adam's apple bobs as he swallows hard, fists clenching at his sides. He says nothing audible in this shot, breathing heavily through flared nostrils. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed, tightening on his face as his eyes glisten more intensely.

[Shot 4] At 00:08.500, the shot cuts back to the reverse angle of the middle-aged woman, settling into the exact composition, lighting, clothing, and background of Picture 2 by the end of the shot. The middle-aged woman (S2) leans forward slightly, her expression one of furious, dismissive outrage as she delivers the final crushing line with escalating volume and venom in a Sichuan dialect: <d>[Chinese] 你看哈你现在变成啥样子的人了，你给我死了这条心嘛！</d> Her eyes wide and round, mouth open in a shout of condemnation. Behind her, the younger woman in the camel coat watches with a concerned, surprised expression. The shot holds as the woman's final words resonate, landing precisely on the pose, framing, and emotional intensity established by Picture 2 at the 11.00-second mark.

overall_soundscape: Warm indoor room ambience hums quietly beneath the heated exchange. Fabric shifts and rustles as both characters lean in and gesture tensely. The man's strained breathing and the woman's sharp intakes of breath are audible between lines, conveying the building pressure of the confrontation.

non_diegetic_music: Low, tense sustained strings at a slow tempo with a gradually rising dissonant undertone, building in volume and pressure through the confrontation before holding on a sharp, unresolved sting at the final line.
